label: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Move NEW sessions to ready green while admitted blue journeys finish with valid state, unresolved pinned clients/work block retirement, and drain stays distinct from rollback retention.
preconditions: Local browser file URL with JavaScript; no server or packages.
One admitted blue cart, one idle old/pinned client, one pending blue work effect.
Green starts unassessed; readiness requires the warm and compatible-state synthetic fixture.
Rollback retention is ten manually advanced synthetic minutes after cutover.
actions: Record advisory nominal weight separately from observed bindings
Admit and finish sessions; read pinned blue client
Reconnect an idle pinned client at a new green session boundary
Advance synthetic clock independently of drain
Roll back NEW admission without killing admitted green journeys
Force unsafe retirement and observe interruption/lost work
Reset all local state and controls

syntheticInput.pinnedClient: old-pinned / learner-pinned / item-P / idle but unresolved
syntheticInput.nominalWeight: Advisory only; model dispatch does not use this percentage.
syntheticInput.requestObservations: Initially empty; only executed model start/read/finish/reconnect operations create rows.

expectedAssertions: Unready or incompatible green cannot receive new admissions.
Ready green receives NEW sessions after the explicit boundary even at nominal 0%.
Existing blue session state is not moved, restarted, or replayed by the boundary.
Observed mixed cohorts and request counters outweigh nominal 100% labels.
Active blue journeys, idle pinned clients, and blue work independently block retirement.
Completed drain and elapsed rollback retention are distinct required gates.
A valid blue completion preserves subject/cart and records one receipt; blue work records one effect.
Unsafe retirement reports FAIL and real modeled interruption/lost work, not a successful migration.
Invalid input fails closed; actual browser keyboard/Reset checks are separately recorded.

verification.browser: Five actual visible owned forceNew file-page blocks passed: keyboard, safe/unsafe retirement, invalid data/Reset, and session-boundary rollback.
verification.acceptance: Pending parent/controller review; no worker-granted acceptance or Kano credit.

iac.reason: Resource-free local training. No Azure resource, package, framework, deployment, or live execution is created or inferred.

cleanup.action: Reset, close, or reload this tab. Only repository lesson/evidence files remain.

limits: All dispatch, cart/state, readiness, pin discovery, work, and retention behavior is synthetic.
Finite known fixtures do not discover real unresolved clients or prove native/platform session affinity, shared-store compatibility, health, or real continuity.
Rollback changes NEW admission only and is offered only inside the declared retention window; it is not data rollback.
30 sessions, 120 requests, 200 actions, and 10000 synthetic minutes bound the local rehearsal.
Node evidence is not browser evidence. Actual browser observations are separately identified in evidence.json.
No native B-S007 proof, completed D-S007 parent, worker acceptance, or awarded Kano credit.
